input.summary: Extend the Section 1.4 access and use rights to Company affiliates on written notice
input.comment: [Playbook] Our licence checklist requires affiliate coverage, so we added a short sentence letting us extend the Section 1.4 access and use rights to our affiliates on written notice to HDI; successor transfer is already preserved by Section 10.3.

ops.newText: the right to use, a computer system on which the Site will be stored and operated, with a direct Internet connection of shared but greater than T-1 bandwidth, plus capacity to process continuously during burst periods. HDI shall also provide the Company with access to HDI's software and Content administration tools for purposes of allowing the Company to monitor current catalog information. The Company may, upon written notice to HDI, permit its affiliates to exercise the Company's rights of access and use under this Section 1.4.
